verdict.rationale: Google publishes MCP Toolbox for Databases, an open-source MCP server under the official googleapis GitHub org, and the probe ties it to BigQuery as the official MCP server. The evidence describes it only generically as a server "for databases" and never documents BigQuery-specific tools, setup, or agent connection steps, so how well it covers BigQuery is unproven. Missing for 10: BigQuery-specific MCP documentation (supported tools, auth, and connection setup), a first-party hosted BigQuery MCP endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connectivity.
